==Description:==
A-60 is a red creature that cycles through 8 faces. It's most popular one is the image with a red smiling face looking to the left, smeared in blood. It makes static upon approach, and sounds like distorted radio chatter when in your room. It has the chance to appear at any door past A-060. It will spawn 50-60 doors back and rush to the current room.

==Behavior==
Spawns a random distance from the main room, being 50-60 rooms back (force set to 50 in Red Rooms), before rushing to the current room where it fades itself out in the middle of the main room. If A-60 sees a player, it will instantly kill them. If a player isn’t fully hidden when A-60 reaches the current room, it will jumpscare them, dealing 50 damage and reducing there max health by 10 points. If a player exits before A-60 fully disappears, A-60 deals rapid damage to them.

==Stats:==
Snipe Type: R&D Style (Non lethal unless under 30 health, in which case you die) Does 50 damage. 

DPS whilst in tables: Snipe DPS, but he can kill you when despawning with his 300 DPS.

Kill radius: 36 (Rushing), 28 (waiting in the middle), 42 (fading out/despawn)

Tracking type: Line of Sight

Movement speed (Rooms 0-749): 250 studs per second [5 rooms/s] - Increases as you get closer to room 750 

Movement speed (Rooms 750-899): 666 studs per second [13.32 rooms/s]

Movement speed (Rooms 900-1000): 1200 studs per second [24 rooms/s]

Movement speed (Rooms 1001+): 500*(SpawnRoomNumber÷200). The minimum is 250 studs/second and maximum is 500 studs/second.

Behavior: Spawns a random distance from the main room, being 50-60 rooms back (force set to 50 in Red Rooms), before rushing to the current room where it fades itself out in the middle of the main room.

==Trivia:==
*A-60 is the second entity you will encounter.
*A-60, like A-200, is an entity that is also in the original Rooms game.
*A-60 can be shot, causing him to despawn faster as well as preventing [[A-60i]] from spawning
*A-60's jumpscare sound comes from the FNAF fangame The Joy of Creation, being Ignited Foxy's jumpscare sound.
*Hiding on a table in a previous room against '''A-60''' cannot kill you, however you will get locker sniped
*A-60 can be dodge rolled to survive though you'll get sniped
